references.text: God's instructions to Moses on making the altar of incense from gold and placing it before the veil, which is now carried out in this verse.
Specifies that the golden altar is to be placed before the veil that is in front of the ark of the testimony, exactly as done here.
Describes Bezalel's crafting of the altar of incense from acacia wood overlaid with gold, which is now being put in its place.
God's command to Moses to set the golden altar for incense before the ark of the testimony and hang up the veil.
Refers to the altar of fragrant incense standing in the tent of meeting before the Lord's presence.
The book of Hebrews refers to the golden altar of incense as part of the sanctuary furnishings behind the second veil.
John's vision of the golden altar before the throne where incense is offered together with the prayers of the saints, a heavenly counterpart to the tabernacle's golden altar.
Complementary instructions on the placement of the two different altars in the structure of the sanctuary.
The candidate lists the object that the source verse describes an action being performed with.
Shows continuity in the gold overlay of the altar from the tent of meeting to Solomon's temple.
The candidate describes the making of the carrying poles for the same altar that is placed in the source verse.
The candidate describes the details of the gold overlay for the same altar that is placed in the source verse.
